description: European cities with Geothermal District Heating and conventional District Heating - GeoDH project Funded by Intelligent Energy Europe Program, Grant Agreement IEE/11/813/SI2.616373 GEODH is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Annamaria Nador (Mining and Geological Survey of Hungary). The dataset includes two shapefiles showing the location data for cities across Europe that use Geothermal District Heating and conventional District Heating. This dataset was developed for assessing the potential of Geothermal District Heating in Europe as part of the GeoDH project (http://geodh.eu/). Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
